Holder(s) under this licence and clearly marked as such. This may
include source files, build scripts and documentation.

"Original Version" refers to the collection of Font Software components
as received under this licence.

"Modified Version" refers to any derivative made by adding to, deleting,
or substituting -- in part or in whole -- any of the components of the
Original Version, by changing formats or by porting the Font Software to
a new environment.

"Copyright Holder(s)" refers to all individuals and companies who have a
copyright ownership of the Font Software.

"Substantially Changed" refers to Modified Versions which can be easily
identified as dissimilar to the Font Software by users of the Font
Software comparing the Original Version with the Modified Version.

To "Propagate" a work means to do anything with it that, without
permission, would make you directly or secondarily liable for
infringement under applicable copyright law, except executing it on a
computer or modifying a private copy. Propagation includes copying,
distribution (with or without modification and with or without charging

## Vendored kernel headers

The uapi headers below are copied unchanged from the Linux kernel and are read at build time by
the crate they sit in. Each keeps the SPDX identifier and the notice the kernel ships it with.

|---|---|---|
| `crates/zgui-drm/uapi/drm.h` | Linux `include/uapi/drm/` | MIT |
| `crates/zgui-drm/uapi/drm_mode.h` | Linux `include/uapi/drm/` | MIT |
| `crates/zgui-drm/uapi/drm_fourcc.h` | Linux `include/uapi/drm/` | MIT |
| `crates/zgui-evdev/uapi/input.h` | Linux `include/uapi/linux/` | GPL-2.0 WITH Linux-syscall-note |
| `crates/zgui-evdev/uapi/input-event-codes.h` | Linux `include/uapi/linux/` | GPL-2.0-only WITH Linux-syscall-note |
| `crates/zgui-evdev/uapi/uinput.h` | Linux `include/uapi/linux/` | GPL-2.0+ WITH Linux-syscall-note |
| `crates/zgui-evdev/uapi/time.h` | Linux `include/uapi/linux/` | GPL-2.0 WITH Linux-syscall-note |
| `crates/zgui-evdev/uapi/time_types.h` | Linux `include/uapi/linux/` | GPL-2.0 WITH Linux-syscall-note |
| `crates/zgui-evdev/uapi/kd.h` | Linux `include/uapi/linux/` | GPL-2.0 WITH Linux-syscall-note |
| `crates/zgui-evdev/uapi/keyboard.h` | Linux `include/uapi/linux/` | GPL-2.0 WITH Linux-syscall-note |
| `crates/zgui-evdev/uapi/wait.h` | Linux `include/uapi/linux/` | GPL-2.0 WITH Linux-syscall-note |

The syscall-note exception states that a user program reaching kernel services through the
interface these headers describe is normal use of the kernel and is outside the reach of the
kernel's own licence. The generated bindings are that use and nothing more.

The font files below are used only by `zgui-text-parley`'s test suite, which runs with system font
enumeration disabled so that shaped advances and rendered pixels are the same on every machine.
They are not linked into any library and are not redistributed as part of a built artefact.
